core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.nextExcessHorizon
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.nextExcessHorizon (a : Nat → Nat) (n₀ : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun a n₀ => Erdos423.stabilizationIndexHorizon a n₀ (HSub.hSub (a n₀) n₀)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon (a : Nat → Nat) (k : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun a k => Nat.iterate (Erdos423.nextExcessHorizon a) k 1

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.stabilizationExpHorizon
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.stabilizationExpHorizon (a : Nat → Nat) (n₀ C : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun a n₀ C =>
  HAdd.hAdd
    (Max.max (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (Max.max n₀ 3) C) (Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub n₀ 1)))
      (Max.max (HAdd.hAdd n₀ 1) (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 n₀) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2)))
    n₀

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.stabilizationIndexHorizon
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.stabilizationIndexHorizon (a : Nat → Nat) (n₀ C : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun a n₀ C => HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (Erdos423.stabilizationExpHorizon a n₀ C)) C

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.completedSquareExpFiber
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.completedSquareExpFiber (a : Nat → Nat) (n₀ C r₀ K i : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun a n₀ C r₀ K i =>
  Finset.filter
    (fun r =>
      Exists fun v =>
        Eq
          (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 v) 1) 2)
            (HMul.hMul 8 (HSub.hSub (Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub n₀ 1)) (Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub i 1)))))
          (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r 3))
            (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 n₀) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2)))
    (Finset.Ico r₀ (HAdd.hAdd r₀ K))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.discriminantOffset
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.discriminantOffset (a : Nat → Nat) (n₀ C i : Nat) : Int :=
  fun a n₀ C i =>
  HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul 8 (HSub.hSub ↑(Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub n₀ 1)) ↑(Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub i 1))))
    ↑(HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 n₀) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.prefixSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.prefixSum (a : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun a n => Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) fun l => a l

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.IsGlobalConsecutiveBlockSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.IsGlobalConsecutiveBlockSum (a : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat) : Prop :=
  fun a m =>
  Exists fun i =>
    Exists fun j => And (LE.le 1 i) (And (LE.le (HAdd.hAdd i 1) j) (Eq m (Finset.sum (Finset.Icc i j) fun l => a l)))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.IsConsecutiveBlockSum
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.IsConsecutiveBlockSum (a : Nat → Nat) (k m : Nat) : Prop :=
  fun a k m =>
  Exists fun i =>
    Exists fun j =>
      And (LE.le 1 i)
        (And (LE.le (HAdd.hAdd i 1) j)
          (And (LE.le (HAdd.hAdd j 1) k) (Eq m (Finset.sum (Finset.Icc i j) fun l => a l))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq (a : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  fun a =>
  And (Eq (a 1) 1)
    (And (Eq (a 2) 2)
      (∀ (k : Nat),
        LE.le 3 k →
          And (Erdos423.IsConsecutiveBlockSum a k (a k))
            (And (LT.lt (a (HSub.hSub k 1)) (a k))
              (∀ (m : Nat), LT.lt (a (HSub.hSub k 1)) m → LT.lt m (a k) → Not (Erdos423.IsConsecutiveBlockSum a k m)))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.erdos_423.variants.nondecreasing
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.erdos_423.variants.nondecreasing (a : Nat → Nat) :
  Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq a → ∀ (n m : Nat), LE.le 1 n → LE.le n m → LE.le (HSub.hSub (a n) n) (HSub.hSub (a m) m)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.erdos_423.variants.unbounded

theorem Erdos423.erdos_423.variants.unbounded (a : Nat → Nat) :

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.strict_excess_increase_of_blockSum_eq_two_pow
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.strict_excess_increase_of_blockSum_eq_two_pow (a : Nat → Nat) :
  Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq a →
    ∀ (i j r : Nat),
      LE.le 1 i →
        LE.le (HAdd.hAdd i 1) j →
          Eq (Finset.sum (Finset.Icc i j) fun l => a l) (HPow.hPow 2 r) → LT.lt (HSub.hSub (a i) i) (HSub.hSub (a j) j)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.completed_square_tail_quadratic_identity
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.completed_square_tail_quadratic_identity (n₀ C j : Nat) :
  LE.le 1 n₀ →
    LE.le n₀ j →
      Eq
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HMul.hMul 4
            (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HSub.hSub j n₀) 1)
              (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 n₀) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) (HSub.hSub j n₀))))
          (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 n₀) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2))
        (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 j) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.exists_completed_square_discriminant_of_two_pow
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.exists_completed_square_discriminant_of_two_pow (a : Nat → Nat) :
  Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq a →
    ∀ (n₀ C r : Nat),
      LE.le 1 n₀ →
        (∀ (n : Nat), LE.le n₀ n → Eq (a n) (HAdd.hAdd n C)) →
          LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (Max.max n₀ 3) C) (HPow.hPow 2 r) →
            LT.lt (Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub n₀ 1)) (HPow.hPow 2 r) →
              Exists fun i =>
                Exists fun j =>
                  And (LE.le 1 i)
                    (And (LT.lt i n₀)
                      (And (LE.le n₀ j)
                        (Eq
                          (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 j) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2)
                            (HMul.hMul 8
                              (HSub.hSub (Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub n₀ 1))
                                (Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub i 1)))))
                          (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r 3))
                            (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 n₀) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2)))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.completed_square_collision_factor_eq
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.completed_square_collision_factor_eq (A B v₁ v₂ r₁ r₂ : Nat) :
  LE.le r₁ r₂ →
    LE.le v₁ v₂ →
      Eq (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 v₁) 1) 2) A) (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₁ 3)) B) →
        Eq (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 v₂) 1) 2) A) (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₂ 3)) B) →
          Eq (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub v₂ v₁) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd v₂ v₁) 1))
            (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₁ 1)) (HSub.hSub (HPow.hPow 2 (HSub.hSub r₂ r₁)) 1))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.two_pow_le_of_completed_square_collision
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.two_pow_le_of_completed_square_collision (A B v₁ v₂ r₁ r₂ : Nat) :
  LT.lt r₁ r₂ →
    Eq (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 v₁) 1) 2) A) (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₁ 3)) B) →
      Eq (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 v₂) 1) 2) A) (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₂ 3)) B) →
        And (LE.le (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₁ 1)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd v₂ v₁) 1)) (LE.le (HPow.hPow 2 r₁) v₂)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.two_mul_le_succ_of_completed_square_collision
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.two_mul_le_succ_of_completed_square_collision (A B v₁ v₂ r₁ r₂ : Nat) :
  LT.lt r₁ r₂ →
    LE.le B (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₁ 3)) →
      Eq (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 v₁) 1) 2) A) (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₁ 3)) B) →
        Eq (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 v₂) 1) 2) A) (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd r₂ 3)) B) →
          LE.le (HMul.hMul 2 r₁) (HAdd.hAdd r₂ 1)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.completedSquareExpFiber_card_le_one
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.completedSquareExpFiber_card_le_one (a : Nat → Nat) (n₀ C r₀ K i : Nat) :
  LE.le (HAdd.hAdd K 1) r₀ →
    LE.le (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 n₀) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2) r₀ →
      LE.le (Finset.card (Erdos423.completedSquareExpFiber a n₀ C r₀ K i)) 1

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.not_eventual_linear_of_isHofstadterSeq
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.not_eventual_linear_of_isHofstadterSeq (a : Nat → Nat) :
  Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq a → ∀ (n₀ C : Nat), LE.le 1 n₀ → Not (∀ (n : Nat), LE.le n₀ n → Eq (a n) (HAdd.hAdd n C))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.exists_stabilization_breaking_index_le
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.exists_stabilization_breaking_index_le (a : Nat → Nat) :
  Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq a →
    ∀ (n₀ C : Nat),
      LE.le 1 n₀ →
        have r₀ :=
          HAdd.hAdd
            (Max.max (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (Max.max n₀ 3) C) (Erdos423.prefixSum a (HSub.hSub n₀ 1)))
              (Max.max (HAdd.hAdd n₀ 1) (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 n₀) (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1) 2)))
            n₀;
        Exists fun n₁ => And (LE.le n₀ n₁) (And (LE.le n₁ (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow 2 r₀) C)) (Ne (a n₁) (HAdd.hAdd n₁ C)))

core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.strict_excess_increase_at_stabilizationIndexHorizon (a : Nat → Nat) :

core_notation_audit.declaration:

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.erdos_423_variants_lower_bound_of_iterExcessHorizon_log_log_le
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.erdos_423_variants_lower_bound_of_iterExcessHorizon_log_log_le (a : Nat → Nat) :
  Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq a →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      LE.le 0 B →
        (∀ (k : Nat),
            LE.le 1 k → LE.le (Real.log (Real.log ↑(Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon a (HAdd.hAdd k 1)))) (HMul.hMul B ↑k)) →
          Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun n => Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) fun n => HSub.hSub ↑(a n) ↑n

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.erdos_423_variants_upper_bound_of_iterExcessHorizon_rpow_le
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.erdos_423_variants_upper_bound_of_iterExcessHorizon_rpow_le (a : Nat → Nat) :
  Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq a →
    ∀ (ε B : Real),
      LT.lt 0 ε →
        LE.le 0 B →
          (∀ (k : Nat),
              LE.le 1 k →
                LE.le
                  (↑(HSub.hSub (a (Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon a (HAdd.hAdd k 1)))
                      (Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon a (HAdd.hAdd k 1))))
                  (HMul.hMul B (HPow.hPow (↑(Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon a k)) (HAdd.hAdd (688 / 413) ε)))) →
            Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun n => ↑(a n)) fun n => HPow.hPow (↑n) (HAdd.hAdd (688 / 413) ε)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos423.erdos_423_of_iterExcessHorizon_littleO_bound
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos423.erdos_423_of_iterExcessHorizon_littleO_bound (a : Nat → Nat) :
  Erdos423.IsHofstadterSeq a →
    (∀ (ε : Real),
        LT.lt 0 ε →
          Exists fun K₀ =>
            And (LE.le 1 K₀)
              (∀ (k : Nat),
                LE.le K₀ k →
                  LE.le
                    (↑(HSub.hSub (a (Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon a (HAdd.hAdd k 1)))
                        (Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon a (HAdd.hAdd k 1))))
                    (HMul.hMul ε ↑(Erdos423.iterExcessHorizon a k)))) →
      Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop (fun n => HSub.hSub ↑(a n) ↑n) fun n => ↑n
